usedFor: Each new Stripe customer fills in columns on a Google Sheets row.

bestTemplate.name: “New Customer Created” in Stripe, then “Update Spreadsheet Row” in Google Sheets
bestTemplate.why: Stripe pushes each new customer as it happens, and the action writes into a single row.

watchOut: “Update Spreadsheet Row” only changes rows already in the sheet, so each customer needs a row first.
